meta.title: 生成式 AI 对工作效率的影响：三项随机对照实验
meta.source: Peng et al. (2023) arXiv:2302.06590；Noy & Zhang (2023) Science 381:187-192；Brynjolfsson, Li & Raymond (2023) NBER w31161
meta.note: 数字均取自论文原文：编程实验的用时为“完成任务者”的平均用时；写作实验取 Science 发表版（时间 −40%、质量 +18%，工作论文版以标准差表述）；客服实验的“资深/高技能员工”原文为“minimal impact”，无具体数值。
meta.usedIn: 2.2 效率：同一项任务，AI 省下多少时间

race.task: 用 JavaScript 实现一个 HTTP 服务器
race.source: Peng, Kalliamvakou, Cihon & Demirer (2023), The Impact of AI on Developer Productivity: Evidence from GitHub Copilot
race.quote: Conditioning on completing the task, the average completion time from the treated group is 71.17 minutes and 160.89 minutes for the control group.

studies.title: 程序员 × GitHub Copilot
studies.who: 95 名专业程序员，随机分为两组
studies.quote: The treatment group, with access to the AI pair programmer, completed the task 55.8% faster than the control group.

studies.title: 专业人士 × ChatGPT
studies.who: 453 名受过大学教育的专业人士，完成本职相关的写作任务
studies.quote: The average time taken decreased by 40% and output quality rose by 18%.

studies.title: 客服坐席 × 生成式 AI 助手
studies.who: 5,179 名客服坐席的真实工作数据
studies.quote: Access to the tool increases productivity, as measured by issues resolved per hour, by 14% on average

gap.title: 谁受益最多：客服坐席的生产率提升
gap.quote: including a 34% improvement for novice and low-skilled workers but with minimal impact on experienced and highly skilled workers

echoes.text: 编程经验较少的开发者受益更多。
ChatGPT 对起点较低者帮助更大，压缩了生产率分布，劳动者之间的不平等缩小。
